scope: Publication-state architecture for property answers. It does not itself establish any property-specific fact.
core_rule: Publication state is determined by evidence, property/date matching, legal-source completeness and audit integrity—not by confidence language alone.
verified_answer_gate: No unresolved material dependency and complete audit provenance.
limited_answer_gate: Core proposition established with explicit material limitations and sufficient provenance.
not_determinable_gate: Required evidence, identity or legal basis remains insufficient for a responsible conclusion.
